stemMarkdown: Walking at 8 km/h a student reaches school 25 minutes late, and walking at 11 km/h he reaches 22 minutes early. Find the distance (in km) to the school. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The two journeys differ in time by $25 + 22 = 47$ minutes $= 0.7833$ hours. If the distance is $d$, then $\dfrac{d}{8} - \dfrac{d}{11} = 0.7833$, giving $d = 22.9778$ km.
